scope_note: Controlled terms for certainty, source quality, research progress, transcription, and identification.
Controlled status group for claim status.
Current evidence materially contradicts the claim.
Meaningful evidence or scholarship on multiple sides.
Former interpretation replaced by stronger evidence.
Some components supported; others unresolved.
Current evidence supports the claim.
Available evidence is insufficient to choose among possibilities or support a firm conclusion.
Repeated claim lacking checked evidence.
Controlled status group for general confidence.
Directly supported with no meaningful ambiguity known.
Substantive competing interpretations exist.
Strong evidence with minor residual uncertainty.
Weak or indirect support; significant uncertainty.
Plausible and supported, but material uncertainty remains.
Candidate identification or interpretation only.
No confidence determination made.
Controlled status group for date status.
Must follow stated date.
Approximate date.
Must precede stated date.
Exact date explicitly documented.
Dated by style, mark, technology, address, code, context, etc.
Bounded interval.
No defensible date currently known.
Controlled status group for identification status.
Identity verified.
Older attribution retained in history but corrected.
Only some attributes or entities identified.
Candidate identification.
Strong but not definitive identification.
No satisfactory identification.
Status of translation for evidence or source material in a language different from the project display language.
Translation reviewed by a qualified or demonstrably proficient reader, with ambiguities documented.
Translation prepared or checked by a human reader.
Automated translation available but not substantively checked by a competent reader.
No translation has been prepared.
Controlled status group for research status.
A relevant source is known but inaccessible, undigitized, restricted, unavailable locally, or requires repository consultation.
Research underway.
Date uncertain or conflicting.
Requires specialist expertise such as language, material culture, bottle dating, restaurant ware, numismatics, archaeology, or food science.
Object, person, place, or product identification outstanding.
Identification, dating, transcription, or condition assessment is limited by image quality or missing views.
Basic cataloging only.
Ownership or custody history incomplete.
Research question substantially resolved with documented evidence.
Relevant source requires translation.
Citation or claim located but original not examined.
Controlled status group for source / evidence type.

preferred_label: Citation-Only / Primary Source Not Yet Examined
scope_note: A citation to a potentially relevant primary source is known, but the cited item has not been directly inspected.
notes: Distinct from an unverified historical claim.

scope_note: Near-contemporary reporting or commentary.
Museum, library, archive, or collection catalogue information.
Evidence inherent in object, mark, manufacturing method, residue, etc.
Recorded or documented testimony.
Popular book, article, documentary, or website.
Original or contemporary source directly examined in scan/original.
Primary source known through dependable transcription.
A reproduction, facsimile, microfilm, photograph, or faithful digital surrogate of an original primary source.
notes: Record quality and completeness of the reproduction.

scope_note: Peer-reviewed or scholarly historical analysis.
Laboratory or quantitative analysis.
Claim located but underlying evidence not verified.
Controlled status group for transcription / ocr status.
Spelling, punctuation, and layout preserved as closely as practical.
Transcription reviewed against source.
No usable transcription.
Normalized spelling or format exists alongside original.
Machine OCR available but not human corrected.
Only part of item transcribed.
